if(CONFIG_VIIKATE_SIM)
  # code/app/src/main.c asserts on a symbol that no longer exists
  # (imu_filter). On the target, assert() is a no-op without CONFIG_ASSERT,
  # so mirror that here instead of failing the host build.
  zephyr_compile_definitions(NDEBUG)

  zephyr_library()
  zephyr_library_include_directories(include)
  zephyr_library_sources(
    src/sim_pwm.c
    src/sim_sensors.c
    src/sim_bridge.c
  )

  if(CONFIG_VIIKATE_SIM_PLANT_TOY)
    zephyr_library_sources(plant/toy_roll_plant.c)
  elseif(CONFIG_VIIKATE_SIM_PLANT_ROCKET)
    # Generated by simulation/matlab/plant/generate_plant.m and committed.
    set(VIIKATE_PLANT_CODEGEN_DIR
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../simulation/plant_codegen)
    file(GLOB VIIKATE_PLANT_CODEGEN_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
         ${VIIKATE_PLANT_CODEGEN_DIR}/*.c)
    if(NOT VIIKATE_PLANT_CODEGEN_SOURCES)
      message(FATAL_ERROR
        "Generated rocket plant not found in simulation/plant_codegen. "
        "Run generate_plant.m or build with --plant toy.")
    endif()
    zephyr_library_include_directories(plant/rocket ${VIIKATE_PLANT_CODEGEN_DIR})
    zephyr_library_sources(
      plant/rocket/rocket_plant.c
      plant/rocket/rocket_frames.c
      ${VIIKATE_PLANT_CODEGEN_SOURCES}
    )
  endif()
endif()
